name: skill-authoring
when_to_use: When authoring, creating, explaining, or inspecting declarative domain skills in Hund's canonical local skill vault.
steps: Define one narrow capability and a `when_to_use` that distinguishes matching from non-matching tasks.
Write 2–8 concrete ordered steps; include only instructions that change an execution decision.
Use 1–12 precise routing triggers; add Swedish aliases only when useful and never use catchalls.
Include 1–2 realistic golden examples with expected outcomes.
Include 2–3 binary verification checks; every claimed result must be decidable as pass or fail.
Keep canonical content in English and never add secrets, permissions, banned actions or speculative edge cases.
verification: create_skill confirms that the schema was validated and persisted as a draft
response to creation inquiries is 1-3 concise plain-text lines in third person
